scope: Targeted legal-portal technology, accessibility, deployment, marketplace, and source review

items.source: Official Node.js releases and Node 22 archive
items.finding: Node 22 remains an LTS line; a newer patched Node 22 release is available than the exact test runtime v22.16.0.
items.actionNow: Preserve the Node 22.x architecture and test compatibility; require deployment runtime patch-level refresh and acceptance rather than an architecture migration.
items.monitorTrigger: A Node 22 security release, end-of-life milestone, or hosting runtime change.

items.source: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation and new success-criteria guidance
items.finding: Focus visibility, target size, consistent help, redundant entry, and accessible authentication remain material for public workflows.
items.actionNow: The new organizer uses explicit labels, visible controls, status announcements, keyboard-compatible native fields, and no authentication barrier.
items.monitorTrigger: New WCAG guidance, accessibility complaint, or failed real-device/assistive-technology acceptance.

items.source: Official npm ci and npm audit documentation plus controlled build attempts
items.finding: The configured npm registry timed out; no clean-install or vulnerability result can be claimed.
items.actionNow: Keep dependencies unchanged, use no packaged shims, preserve fail-closed truth, and rerun npm ci/audit when registry access is available.
items.monitorTrigger: Registry availability or a dependency advisory.

items.finding: External AI and confidential production upload processing remain unapproved.
items.actionNow: Implement a deterministic device-only date organizer rather than transmitting sensitive dates or implying deadline calculation.
items.monitorTrigger: Approved provider, storage, privacy, security, and human-escalation evidence.

items.source: Current professional-controlled firm, team, office, and attorney pages reviewed 2026-07-24
items.finding: Qualifying Phase One inventory remained available across all six priority regions.
items.actionNow: Add 36 source-tracked attorneys and 7 firms while retaining unclaimed/unverified/unpaid/non-participating states.
items.monitorTrigger: Source staleness, correction request, claim request, duplicate finding, or geographic diminishing returns.

rejectedTrends.trend: Activate external AI for date or deadline calculations
rejectedTrends.reason: No approved provider/privacy/retention/authoritative-rule system or live operational evidence; deterministic organization provides value without unsupported deadline claims.
No verified material user benefit over the existing supported Node 22.x architecture in this release; patch-level currency is the appropriate action.

rejectedTrends.trend: Open uploads, payments, booking, reviews, or unrestricted routing
rejectedTrends.reason: Required production infrastructure, professional-responsibility, support, and live acceptance evidence remain unavailable.
